decisions.reason: As a classic close-to-core handle line, it is relatively inexpensive for a large broad-range supplier to retain and can still fill standard project demand even though by 2022 its market potential should be largely known.

After several years a single incremental handle design with no clear continuing visibility is no longer a valuable option in a broad portfolio, so resources are better released for stronger lines and new development.
Because uncertainty about this close-to-core design should now be mostly resolved and the firm already has many neighboring offerings, pruning it is the more likely choice.

Despite higher carrying costs, the electronic access system remains aligned with the firm's digital system direction, so management would more likely keep it unless it is being explicitly replaced by a newer platform.
